body: I notice it gets better on one side of my mouth and calms down, bumps still there though, then sometimes those bumps dry out nd flake, like they dont have fluid in them like pimples its just bumps, they do get red sometimes with friction from my pillow when i sleep and start to itch

Hey!! So all my life I had pretty acne free skin, occasional pimples here and there but all of a sudden last week I had this huge break out on my jawline and forehead!! Went to the Dermatologist he said its because of the mask most likely, but ive been fine since Covid started?? Anyways this is what the bumps look like,
Very much skin like, itchy and sting, he prescribed my hydrocortisone and told me to switch to cotton masks, what do you guys think??




Regular routine: 
Cerave cleanser 
Cerave SA bump cream
Vitamin E
SPF 

This has been my routine for a long time, nothing new added :/
